# Fonts

Self-hosted so the page loads nothing from other origins (see `scripts/csp.cjs`).

| File | Family | Designer | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Rajdhani-Bold.ttf` | Rajdhani Bold | Indian Type Foundry | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `Ubuntu-Regular.ttf`, `Ubuntu-Italic.ttf`, `Ubuntu-Bold.ttf` | Ubuntu | Dalton Maag for Canonical | Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 |

Source: the Fonts.zip kit in the Civil Air Patrol Brand Guide (Typography page),
https://civilairpatrol.frontify.com. The license named above is the one recorded in each font file's name table.
The kit itself carries no license files, so the full texts should be added here before redistribution:
OFL at https://openfontlicense.org and the Ubuntu Font Licence at https://ubuntu.com/legal/font-licence.

These are TrueType files. Converting to WOFF2 would cut their size considerably.
